title: Presolana mountain long run, 2 tempo climbs
terrain: mountain trail, ~850m D+, power-hike steep climbs, controlled descents

steps.target: Z2, 145-155bpm, power-hike steep climbs, cadence 174+ on flats

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 2h30, ~850m D+ (800-900). Hike anything steep to stay under 155bpm outside the two tempo climbs. Climbs #1 and #2 at 160-166bpm, 12min each on separate climbs, easy descent between. Descents controlled, cadence 170+. icu load 130, Garmin ~160-190.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 3 flasks Tailwind (500ml, 2 scoops each), one per ~45min from min 20, plus 1 Carbo Gel at ~1h45. Gut rehearsal of the new mix.
STOP RULE: HRV under 55 or RHR over 51 Saturday morning, run the original 2h/600m version with one 18min climb. Above 2,000m HR is unreliable, climb at RPE 4. Walk down if cadence drops under 165 or quads are shot.
WHY: HRV 77-79 for three days and TSB ~0 = under-stimulated. Upgraded from 100 to push the week out of the grey zone.
